title: 2026 refrigerant GWP and blend QA controls

sources.title: 2026 Government greenhouse gas conversion factors: methodology paper

facts.source_fact: There were no major refrigerant/process methodological changes in the 2026 update.
Most refrigerant and process factors remained constant from the 2023 publication.
R-511A was corrected in 2026 from 6.9 kgCO2e/kg to 0 kgCO2e/kg.
The correction reflects a 95/5 R-290 and E-170 blend rather than the previously used R-290 and HFC-152a mixture.
Most GWP values use the IPCC Fifth Assessment Report.
Where AR5 lacks a refrigerant value, the methodology may use AR6, AR4 or Annex IV of EU F-gas Regulation 517/2014.
Blend GWP values are calculated from component GWPs weighted by percentage composition.
Kyoto and non-Kyoto blend components are calculated separately where needed.
Only a limited selection of common blends is presented in the refrigerant tables.
The refrigerant factors are company-reporting conversion factors and are not measurements of a specific equipment leak or parcel.
facts.expected_handling: Do not infer asset-specific emissions without activity data.
